title: Crouch Grow
description: A plugin that let you grow crops by crouching.
body:
## Feature:

Crouching near crops make them grow, at the cost of using some hungar.

## Config:


| Name             | Description                          | default |
|------------------|--------------------------------------|---------|
| random-tick-amount  | Amount of time crops try to grow       |  5  |
| hungar          | Hungar required           |  1  |
| radius       | Radius of crops growing |  5      |


While the config does not have values limit, setting values too large or too small may cause unintended effect.

## Notes:

Inspired by [Squat Grow](https://modrinth.com/mod/squat-grow)

Crops will only grow if they can grow natrually (eg. enough light level).
